about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Ahmed El-Deriny Printing — The Edifice of Printing Since 1918
about.p1: Since 1918, we have been at the heart of Egypt's printing industry. Ahmed El-Deriny Printing is not just a press — it is a family legacy spanning over a century of craftsmanship.
about.p2: From banners and roll-ups to stamps, business cards, and flyers — we blend the authenticity of the past with modern technology.
about.p3: Our professional team carries the spirit of 1918 in every order. Upload your design and calculate your price instantly.
